component.name: Insight Poster
component.summary: Score social posts with an LLM and draft your own

description.p: Insight Poster is a Linux desktop application for people who run a Facebook Page and want the drafting work done for them. You paste in the posts worth reacting to, it scores them against criteria you define, and it writes an original post in your own tone for you to approve.

ul.li: Import by hand: paste the text, author and link of a post from Facebook, Instagram or a search result. Nothing is scraped, so there is no account to get banned.
Score against your own criteria: six weighted criteria are set up for you (engagement, relevance, sentiment, insight, brand safety, clarity) and you can change the weights or add your own.
Any model on OpenRouter: hundreds of models, free ones included, chosen separately for scoring and for writing.
Topic rotation: give each weekday its own topic so Monday and Thursday do not read the same, or override it for one run.
Review before publishing: drafts wait in a review queue where you edit, approve or reject them. Publishing straight to your Page without review is available but off by default.
Keys in your keyring: the OpenRouter key and the Page access token are stored by the OS keyring, never in the database, a config file or a log.
Runs on a schedule while the window is open, or from the command line so a systemd timer can drive it.

description.p: Publishing needs a Facebook Page you administer and a Page access token from a Meta developer app you create yourself. Everything before publishing — importing, scoring and drafting — works with just an OpenRouter key.
